data: Beautiful game, I highly recommend it
A great game with a great story
challenging enough that if you are, it's still so fun
Great story, great gameplay, great graphics, great soundtrack
Chill game with unique mechanics, highly recommend to play it blind, it's really rewarding

100% completion in about 12 hours. Beautiful game, just challenging enough to be incredibly rewarding without frustration. My only complaint is that there's not more of it, but maybe it was just long enough. Each area lasted just the right amount of time to not get stale, but still made the next area feel refreshing. The way the "puzzle" builds as the game progresses was perfect

Love these language-deciphering type games
This is a pretty full game, with many languages to decipher, many diversified cultures and showing that when you surpass the language and culture barrier, you understand that everybody is the same, a human

With love, AchM4sterPro <3

Amazing game. A must-play for anyone who likes puzzles.

I was a little worried that the language translation would be too difficult, tedious, and frustrating, but it is really streamlined. Your journal is broken into sections of 3-5 words, and if you correctly solve all 3-5 in a section, they "lock" into place and your answers are verified.

If you are really stuck on a single word, but know all the other words on the page, the verification feature lets you brute force it pretty quickly if you choose to do so. It is a really nice built in "i'm stuck, help me out" feature.

Fantastic game in all aspects. Absolutely wow!

It's beautiful, the music is superb, environments are original, puzzles are fun and interconnected and nonlinear. Similar to Outer Wilds from this description, but utterly different.

This was an awesome game for puzzle lovers. I am not big into crytography, but this game was still very interesting to me. I loved that it could make me feel smart for little connections I made with similarities in shapes and styles of symbols, and how you could use your understanding of the culture of a language and how it is used to figure out what words mean. Really cool game overall, a great expirience for me!

I loved this game so much!!! The puzzles are really fun and engaging and also very intuitive. It was so fun to decipher all the languages. The visual style is also absolutely beautiful and the music is really atmospheric. I would definitely recommend it!
Some odd choices here and there but overall an entertaining and unique puzzle game, that lasts longer than I thought it would.

One of the best puzzle games I've ever played. You really do start to feel like you're learning a new language while playing this, and as each new challenge unfolds, it is the most satisfying feeling you can have when you figure out what you're being told. I also love the art style, very similar to that of Sable (another great game you must check out if you love exploration), and it's been done cleverly enough that you can get hints from the visual design about what the words mean if you really pay attention. I strongly recommend this game if you love puzzles, though if it's not your favourite genre, maybe wait for a sale.

I have never played a game like this before and I wish I could play it again for the first time so badly. A game based on words and language is so unique but its far from boring, there are so many puzzles and problems to solve in this game. Its actually quite difficult. I had to use a guide a few times especially in the later levels but the feeling you get when getting a translation right on your first guess is so addicting! If you like puzzle games give this a try its so different than anything else you've played!
amazing game, some of the puzzles get a bit tricky if you don't use the hints to show you what you can look at or interact with but it's overall very fun to learn the languages

Everything about this game is great - the music, the level design, the puzzles, the art style. I had a blast 100%-ing this game in one sitting. Figuring out the translations was SUPER rewarding. This game deserves all the praise I've seen about it! (Only tiny complaint: I played with an X-Box controller and one section wouldn't let me do the thing I needed to solve the puzzle. Had to switch to keyboard and mouse for one second to get it to work.)

Absolutely stunning, intruiging and well thought through game. I enjoyed it so much. It truly has everything from stealth, to puzzles and beautiful little "human" interactions.
Couldn't recommend it enough!!

This is a very calming, atmospheric, intriguing short indie game. The soundtrack is fantastic, the artstyle is beautiful and the puzzles are interesting but do not overstay their welcome.

The achievements are easy to get, so no hunting for obscure locations or puzzles, and you can easily 100% the game at any time, even right before finishing it.

I won't analyze too much as the game is short and has 3 forms of gameplay. Figuring out puzzles via interaction with the environment, guessing/estimating which symbols mean what, and stealth. They are all fun in their own right.

The only source of frustration I had in the game is backtracking through the very maze-like later areas, but anyone with a bit more sense of direction shouldn't have this problem.

Overall, solid game, 8/10, would be higher but I am not generally into these types of games.
Never thought a game about fictional languages could be so amazing. I really enjoyed the music and the story, keep it up!

Absolutely gorgeous game, with a very interesting lore you find out on your own throughout the playthrough. It feels like there are a lot of pieces that are slowly brought together, and feels very satisfying to solve.

My only complaint is the last few puzzles containing flashing images, combined with confusing solutions that weren't clear even when looking at a guide. I understand it's supposed to be harder to get the real ending, but I had everything else I needed already, and honestly don't believe I should have struggled to much at that stage of the game.
Unraveling the languages and mysteries of the tower is super satisfying. Gives me a feeling few games manage to.

This is one of my all time favorite games. I have a bachelors degree in linguistics and this was a game I never knew I needed in my life until I saw the Secret Sleepover Society stream of it. I actually stopped watching the stream so that I could buy the game and play the entire thing in one sitting. I've decided now to start an annual tradition of replaying it because it's so satisfying. 10/10 I love this game.
Great game. Unique. Features fun puzzles and 5 languages, cultures, people, worlds to explore, enjoy and study. As someone who loves learning languages, this was perfect. One of my favorite games

A beautiful puzzle game that has little hand holding, and requires you to think. 

The obvious (but not bad) message about language and class is blatant, but it's done in such a pleasant way that it's hard to roll your eyes at, especially with how the game was delivered. 

The only problem I have is how easy is it to get lost, and requires a lot of backtracking. 

Still a wonderful game to get if you like puzzles, language, and dialogue (ironically) light entertainment.
tricky, but fair and quite clever at times. The fixed camera is sometimes irritating for movement, but also can create some very cool scenes.

A beautiful game about deciphering languages.
This game captures how it feels to start learning a language from scratch way better than I expected, the recognition of patterns, the logic of the grammar, the construction of sentences, all of them are part of the mysteries of each of the game's 5 languages.
Presentation is fantastic throughout the whole game, and the gameplay is lenient enough to not overstay its welcome and become boring or frustrating, and finding answers always feels satisfying. Even the rudimentary stealth sections aren't intrusive since they are short and easy enough.
The final revelation was fantastic too!

This game was such a delight to play! I had heard about the language mechanic and was worried that I'd need real paper to keep track, but the built in book mechanic worked perfectly for helping me keep track of my guesses on what each word meant. The helpful illustrations, having 3-5 glyphs on each page, and the inclusion of your guesses and/or the actual word was really helpful in intuitively working through the languages! That core mechanic in conjunction with the world building was such a delight, such that I really didn't want to put the game down. I loved just how you got so much insight into each culture not only when learning the language in their world, but then even further when you started seeing glimpses onto the other cultures and how they viewed one another.

There's small things that I would've enjoyed some adjustment to, but it's nothing significant enough to detract from the overall experience. Enjoy!

Amazing Game
The puzzles are not too hard, but who cares, you're here for the journey through words and worlds.
Amazing art and ideas, definitely an indie gem.
Too bad you cannot really replay it.
Absolutely incredible game. I have never played one like it before. The whole concept and process of deciphering the languages was really fun to do.

Very cool game. Made liberal use of steam's notes feature so I could keep track of each language's sentence structure. Highly recommend, and don't be too intimidated by being stuck. The way the puzzles are set up make it very easy to brute force most of them if you choose to do so when you are very stuck.

I really thought i would like this game given that i'm a big fan of languages but it feels like most solutions are spoonfed to you and couple that with nightmarish stealth gameplay i'm fairly turned off from continueing past the first few hours of the game. Not to mention the sound effects are like ear-piercing high pitch noices that make me physically flinch when playing with sound on.
Great puzzles and everything. Some puzzles went over my head, or I just had to guess, but It's amazingly fun when things just click.

Worth the money spent. I really enjoyed all the puzzles and trying to figure out the languages. I also have an appreciation to all the small details involved, especially seen in the last part.
I've read some would have liked a map, but I just considered it an additional puzzle, considering how labyrinthine the floors could be. :)

Excellent game. Puzzles are well designed, the ambiance is great and the story is engaging.
Mechanics are simple and you won't get stuck too much.
Brilliant concept.
It's a puzzle game yes but it also appeals to you, the player, to actually do more than admire. One of the best uses of geometric design I've seen.

A metroidbrainia where progression is truly based on your knowledge of the game's languages and understanding of the different peoples' cultures. The game is relatively short, but I think if it was any longer it would have dragged a bit. I really enjoyed it!

Deciphering languages is honestly not something I have thought of before for game, but man its so fun. I love all the little puzzles to do and the clues you get. This game really makes me use my brain; I wouldn't say its a crazy hard game, but its definitely not boringly easy. I also think the story is really enjoyable, and the art style is just beautiful! 10/10 gem

Instantly one of my favourite games. I started playing it with high expectations, literally telling the friend I was streaming it to about some linguistics concepts I thought would make good gameplay, only to discover the devs had clearly considered those concepts and worked them into the game in a really fun way. Loved it.
Very interesting game, I'm just a bit through it but it is really satisfying deciphering the glyphs
Extremely satisfying puzzles, and fabulous art direction. If you like exploration/puzzle games without combat, extremely strong recommendation. Recommend going in blind and exploring the game.
Really fun puzzle game. Think it's really interesting to think about decoding a language like this

As a person who enjoys language puzzle games, Chants of Sennaar really delivered. Truly enjoyable experience, with very interesting mechanic for guessing meanings of words and adorable story. Some puzzles that weren't language based very simple-ish, but still fun. Maybe only one puzzle stumped me enough to look up some hints on whats it about.
Incredible puzzle game, with a calm and relaxing environment. Game design and music is on point, glad to see it's a french game! 🇫🇷🥖🥐🇫🇷

Really really good puzzle game where the languages are the biggest parts of the puzzles. Not super long, not super difficult, but a great experience!
I'd love more of this!

Chants of Sennar exists at the axis of my love of language and my love of puzzle games and so, of course, I love it. Navigation might be confusing sometimes but the game's vibes are lovely and the satisfaction you get from putting the words together with their concepts is consistent. I love the grammatical and structural compositions of the different languages and their unique cultural interpretations of similar concepts. It's just! so well thought-out!! I've played it twice all the way through and I'm happy to say that due to its mechanical premise, this game has a surprising amount of replay value. Give yourself some time to wipe the slate clean and you can rediscover these languages all over again. Absolutely recommend.

Chants of Sennaar surprised me. I've always enjoyed linguistics, the idea that language shapes interaction and perception has always stood out to me. To play a game that focused so heavily on language as a puzzle was refreshing and at at times challenging. I played through this game mostly on the Steam Deck and found no problems there. When you finally make a connection and resist the urge to cheat and look up the real meaning of a glyph or symbol, you feel like a champion. If you're looking to try a puzzle that is relaxing and a bit off the beaten path, this is a good contender.

I loved the way this game made me feel clever as I was unravelling the meaning behind the words in each languages. The use of an in-game notebook helped note down potential ideas and really added to this feeling of investigation. I personally liked the puzzles, I felt they were challenging enough without being overly complicated, and the game does hold your hand a little bit at times but it didn't bother me as I felt it kept the pace going. Lovely visuals, beautiful colours, soothing music and a mysterious story. It ticked all the boxes.

As a dude who kinda speaks two languages, this game captured the essence of learning a language from the start very well. It all makes sense. I had a lovely time translating everything, and the story of my journey to the top of the tower was delightful.

Exceptionally original game, enjoyed it thoroughly! Slightly disappointed in the fact that the last language translates itself when I was expecting it to be the biggest challenge, but that's a "me" problem that should not keep you from getting this gem :)
One of the best puzzle games I've played. Definitely the best language puzzle game I've played.

10/10 Perfect match between the background setting and gameplay; everything integrates seamlessly. The creator of this game is undoubtedly not only highly talented but also exceptionally knowledgeable

满分神作，最佳的背景设定和游戏玩法匹配，一切都无缝融合。这个游戏的创作者绝对是才华横溢，而且博学多才。
满脑子只想学外语（

Superb game!

My only critique is length/how rushed the end feels(eventho its technically not that short). The game does the main part of the gameplay loop for you in that level so just think of it as a good sized finale rather than a whole extra level. Anyway I feel an extra hour of gameplay would have been welcome. But I did enjoy the time I was able to spend with Chants of Sennaar.

Great game! I'm not a fan of heavy puzzles because I suck at noticing stuff but this game managed to capture my attention for the entirety of the story. It's so cool to see all the different languages connect to one another and converge into the ending. Some parts really tested my linguistic abilities but it was super satisfying to be able to solve the puzzles without any guides (though I needed a guide for 3 of them but that's just me being impatient). 9/10 game would decipher fictional languages again.
Very fun puzzle game, one for people chasing that Curse of the Golden Idol/Return of the Obra Dinn dopamine hit, but equally playable on its own right.

A well designed puzzle game that falls into that great yet saddening category of games you'll only ever play once. Art design, game play loop, and scoring are exceptionally well done, but unless you suffer a traumatic brain injury after you complete the game, its a one and done sort of deal.

TLDR: Highly recommended and fun, but enjoy it while it lasts.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (98%): players most often praise the art and the story.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, so no single issue stands out.

details.text: Recent reviews hold at the same 98% as the all-time score.
Players with under 2 hours logged are less positive, at 76%, than players with longer playtimes.
